claims.claim_text: Sidewalks and walkways should be as level as possible, slip resistant, not steeper than 1:20 where possible, and have a maximum 1:100 cross gradient.

source_support.source_label: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR - National Council on Disability Affairs
source_support.raw_pdf_path: vitruvius-connection/001_Raw-Source-Layer/001-Laws/BP-344/2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations Batas Pambansa Blg. 344 _ National Council on Disability Affairs.pdf
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: The source sets level/slip-resistant walkways, 1:20 or 5 percent gradient where possible, and 1:100 or 1 percent cross gradient.

claims.claim_text: Sidewalks, walkways, and pathways need 1500 mm minimum width, or 1800 mm where two wheelchair users pass.

source_support.source_label: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR - National Council on Disability Affairs
source_support.raw_pdf_path: vitruvius-connection/001_Raw-Source-Layer/001-Laws/BP-344/2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations Batas Pambansa Blg. 344 _ National Council on Disability Affairs.pdf
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: Minimum width is 1500 mm; two wheelchair users require 1800 mm.

claims.claim_text: Rest or passing spaces must be 1800 mm clear, spaced up to 12000 mm apart, with turnabout spaces near dead-end corridors.

source_support.source_label: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR - National Council on Disability Affairs
source_support.raw_pdf_path: vitruvius-connection/001_Raw-Source-Layer/001-Laws/BP-344/2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations Batas Pambansa Blg. 344 _ National Council on Disability Affairs.pdf
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: Spaces have 1800 mm clear dimension, maximum 12000 mm between rest stops, and turnabouts within 3500 mm of dead-end corridors.

claims.claim_text: Sidewalk/walkway headroom must not be less than 2200 mm, and barriers must leave at least 900 mm clear passage.

source_support.source_label: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR - National Council on Disability Affairs
source_support.raw_pdf_path: vitruvius-connection/001_Raw-Source-Layer/001-Laws/BP-344/2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations Batas Pambansa Blg. 344 _ National Council on Disability Affairs.pdf
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: Headroom is not less than 2200 mm; barriers require at least 900 mm clearance.

claims.claim_text: Open spaces need defined edges/tactile surfaces, and direct drops of 200 mm or more need edge protection at least 100 mm high and 100 mm wide.

source_support.source_label: BP 344 2024 Revised IRR - National Council on Disability Affairs
source_support.raw_pdf_path: vitruvius-connection/001_Raw-Source-Layer/001-Laws/BP-344/2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations Batas Pambansa Blg. 344 _ National Council on Disability Affairs.pdf
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: Open spaces use defined edges and tactile surfaces; direct drops of 200 mm or more need 100 mm by 100 mm edge protection.
